text: The initiative explicitly includes urban drainage works in DRFA Category B, providing regulatory flexibility to shift funds between council accounts. It establishes time-bound repair pathways, such as Emergent Works, Immediate Reconstruction Works, and Essential Public Asset Reconstruction Works, to expedite repairs. The initiative is complemented by clean-up funding through the Community Relief Program and aligns with broader mitigation planning through the Disaster Ready Fund.

metadata.solution_name: DRFA Category B TC Alfred funding for urban drainage works
